title: setMaxTin uncapped (sole Leg-A PSM guard) — SUPPRESSED under KI-4 (owner-trust, setting prices), kept VISIBLE
suppressedUnder: KI-4 (owner-trust for registering dispatchers, setting prices, pausing, emergency withdraw)
suppressedReason: setMaxTin sets the maximum PSM tin (fee) — a price/fee-setting owner action squarely inside KI-4. Law-3 test 'would a competent non-malicious owner be surprised by this consequence?' => No: the function name and NatSpec make the raised-fee-ceiling consequence obvious, and PSM sellGem is fixed-rate so exposure is bounded to the accepted tin fee (not an open-ended drain). Obvious consequence => trusted => suppress. NO label minted. Contrast L-13, whose ETH-folding consequence is NON-obvious => kept.
law1VisibleAction: Kept VISIBLE (not silently dropped). Manual-review park carried forward: triage should explicitly confirm the deployed maxTin default (1e16 = 1%) stays tight — the suppression is of the no-hard-cap-in-code finding, NOT a blessing of an arbitrarily high runtime value.
